summary: Cornerstone Building Brands filed an 8-K on September 9, 2026 disclosing that, effective September 1, 2026, the board appointed Matthew E. Garth, 52, as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, succeeding the prior CFO. Garth most recently was CFO of Dentsply Sirona and earlier CFO of Scotts Miracle-Gro. His offer letter provides a $750,000 annual base salary, a 90%-of-salary target bonus (both pro-rated for 2026), and a one-time grant of 202,777.78 Class B Profit Units under the Camelot Return Ultimate 2022 Equity Incentive Plan. No arrangements, family relationships or related-party transactions were disclosed. Routine CFO transition, not a forced or abrupt departure; watch for severance or transition terms and any strategic or capital-allocation signals from the new finance chief.
